evidence.decision: Decides requested versus known nonsecret data, choices versus typing, permission needs and understandable required-data gating.
evidence.artifact: Produces field/data-source/validation/gating specification or scoped corrected flow while preserving the product and stack.
evidence.transformation: Expense form removes duplicate currency entry, eliminates prefilled password, restores receipt-ID paste and explains missing continuation input.
evidence.verification: Checks partial/invalid/valid values, locale, paste, secret handling and gating reason; exposed secrets or unexplained dead ends fail.
evidence.applicability: Qualifies Mac expansion tooltips and source-specific visionOS secure AirPlay fields without generalizing privacy to all mirrored content.
evidence.handoffs: Text fields and Virtual keyboards address component/input specifics; Privacy is conditional on relevant data access.
evidence.distinctiveness: Reuse versus request, intermediate validation and completion gating are consequential data-entry choices.
